# Eye & Pen

> An indie travel blog by Jessica featuring photography, destination guides, and stories from solo adventures around the world.

Eye & Pen is a personal travel blog focused on budget travel, travel photography, and destination guides. Jessica shares her experiences as a solo female traveler with an emphasis on practical travel tips and visual storytelling.
